town_description: Lohardaga is the headquarters town of Lohardaga district in Jharkhand, set on the Chota Nagpur plateau amid bauxite-rich hills and forests. It is known for several ancient Shiva temples, including the hilltop Mahadev temple and the Prachin Shiv Mandir at nearby Khakparta village. The Nalkari river flows through the district.
